title: Launch synchrony manifest and locality checkpad (Dec 2026) - draft
content:
Purpose: compact, pragmatic runbook for a mid-week (Tue->Wed) feature launch that needs cross-region locality pins and a quick rollback path. This is intentionally terse so on-call and launch operators can follow a single page.

Summary: rollout lanes are 'synchrony' (coordinated across two regions) + 'locality-anchor' (pin to nearest region for privacy-sensitive customers). We will run a two-step canary: 1) 5% traffic in primary region (us-west-2) for 30m, 2) 10% cross-region (us-west-2 + eu-west-1) for 60m, then ramp to 50% for 3h before full promotion. Total launch window ~6 hours.

Owners and roster:
- Launch lead: Aisha Patel (pager)
- Observability: Mei Chen
- Infra / autoscale: Ravi Singh
- Networking & locality: Diego Martinez
- Docs & comms: Elena Korolev

Pre-launch checklist (T-48h -> T-1h):
- Final smoke-suite green on staging and pre-prod (tenant sampling + KV cache warmup) [Mei]
- Canary model variant built and verified for quantization path; artifact SHA pinned [Ravi]
- Locality routing rule created and validated in staging; ensure fallback to global route retains token quotas [Diego]
- Rollout playbook posted to #release with summary and watchlist; set 2h follow-up reminders [Elena]
- Release notes draft ready (user-facing harm/feature bullets) and legal/compliance ack if customers in EU flagged [Aisha]
- Run quick cost-projection for 24h at 50% traffic (expected spend delta) and post to thread [Ravi]

Launch timeline (concise):
T0: Open watch channel, start 5% canary in us-west-2. Begin 30m observation.
T+30m: If canary stable -> expand to 10% across us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Observe 60m.
T+90m: If stable -> increase to 50% (3h). Trigger broader perf tests and user-signal checks.
T+270m: If stable -> promote to full. Start 24h intensified telemetry sampling; schedule follow-up retro.

Telemetry & success criteria (pass/fail signals):
- Latency P95 not exceed baseline P95 + 25% for 15m window.
- Error-rate (5xx + quota-denied) under 0.5% of requests and no persistent client-facing regressions.
- Cost-per-token delta within pre-approved budget envelope (+/- 35%).
- Quality signal: automated smoke-evals on golden prompts show <= 1.5% drift in top-1 similarity.

Immediate rollback triggers (anyone may call):
- Latency P95 > baseline + 50% sustained for 5m.
- Error-rate > 2% for 10m or any sustained user-visible outages.
- Data locality misrouting observed (customer in EU routed outside EU) -> rollback immediately.

Rollback steps (fast path):
1) Pause new rollouts and cut traffic to previous model variant (API gateway route switch).
2) Notify watch channel with rollback reason, incident ticket id, and who executed rollback.
3) Rollback owner ensures KV cache TTLs and KV eviction policy restored if needed.
4) Start incident retrospective template (see postmortem section).

Deviation/mitigation guidelines:
- If canary shows mild latency spikes but no errors: throttle ramp, extend observation window by doubling next step time.
- For region-specific anomalies: isolate region, shift locality pins temporarily to alternate region, keep telemetry sampling elevated.

Release notes draft (user-facing / internal):
Title: Improved routing and cost-smoothing for inference pipelines (Dec 2026)
Bullet highlights:
- More reliable locality-aware routing to reduce cross-border inference for EU customers.
- Model variant: quantized kernel improvements for lower per-token latency in long context workloads.
- Operational: canary rollout support for synchronized cross-region launches to reduce variability.
Known limitations & guidance:
- Temporary cache-warmup may cause slightly higher token latency for first 30 minutes after promotion.
- If you use pinned dedicated pools, contact support to coordinate migration windows.

Post-release immediate retro template (fill in):
- Time of complete promotion:
- Observed latency/error deviations and timestamps:
- Root cause hypothesis:
- Actions (who/what/by when):
- Customer/partner outreach required? (Y/N) details:

Notes and reminders:
- Keep the watch channel focused: no unrelated threads. Use incident ticket for long-form notes.
- Preserve artifacts: model artifact SHA, gateway route diffs, autoscaler events, and sampled traces.
- If rollback is executed, create a short 'rollback postmortem' within 24h and a more detailed retro within 72h.

Quick appendix: useful commands and queries (ops cheat-sheet):
- Canary toggle (api): POST /internal/rollouts/toggle {version: "v2-canary", percent: 5}
- Query p95 latency (metrics): metric query: latency_p95{route="inference",env="prod"}
- Tail inferred errors: logs query: service:inference AND level:error AND timestamp:now-15m

Open questions / items to resolve before T-0:
- Confirm legal review for EU locality change (pending from Legal as of 2026-11-19).
- Validate that consumer-facing docs contain clear guidance for pinned pools (Elena to confirm).
- Decide whether to enable prefix-KV aggressive prewarm in us-west-2 (Ravi to decide by T-6h).

End of page — keep this doc lean; copy into the watch channel and update the release ticket when ready.
